variants.name: Спокойный рабочий интерфейс
variants.prompt:
Create a high fidelity, exceptionally well designed desktop application UI concept screenshot for Testoritto, a local Git-backed manual QA test case management application. This is a proposed NEW UX/UI, not an illustration. Flat straight-on full application screenshot in landscape 16:10, approximately 1600x1000, crisp readable Russian interface text, no perspective, no device mockup, no decorative background outside app. Render one complete screen.
Product constraints: desktop dark-first, restrained Citadelic palette: background #141518, panels #1a1b1e and #202124, selected surface #26272b, off-white text #d9dad8, muted slate blue primary accent #5e7b96. Restrained semantic sage green #85b294 and amber #d9a55b for status only. No purple, neon, gradients, glassmorphism, giant shadows, AI illustrations or marketing. Beautiful practical typography, 14–16px body equivalent, clear 26–30px document title, sufficiently contrasted readable secondary labels, generous click targets, polished small line icons, precise alignment, economical borders. Existing components may be redesigned; make this feel like a carefully authored professional QA desktop app. No invented authentication, avatars, dashboards, charts, AI buttons, branch switching or cloud services.
Same content and user state across directions: app name "Testoritto"; repository switcher "PayFlow QA"; static Git branch label "main"; main navigation "Кейсы", "Прогоны", "Git" with subtle count 3 for Git changes. Workspace "Платежи". Search "Найти кейс". Current case "PAY-042" with title "Успешная оплата картой". Status "Активен"; tags "smoke" and "checkout". Context breadcrumbs "Платежи / Оплата картой". Primary top-right action "Сохранить", and clear adjacent small state "Есть изменения" with dot, visually distinct from Git actions; secondary overflow menu for duplicate/move/delete. Contextual create button "Новый кейс", not a wall of action buttons.
Editor content: section "Цель" with "Проверить оплату заказа банковской картой."; "Подготовка" with "Пользователь вошёл в аккаунт. В корзине есть товар."; numbered "Шаги": "Открыть оформление заказа", "Выбрать оплату картой", "Подтвердить оплату"; section "Ожидаемый результат" with "Заказ оплачен. Отображается номер заказа.". Content must look like useful actual editable testing data, with tidy section affordances and numbered step rows. Populate adjacent case list with PAY-041 "Оплата через СБП", PAY-042 "Успешная оплата картой", PAY-043 "Отклонённая карта", PAY-044 "Возврат платежа", grouped into "Оплата картой" and "Возвраты". The selected case is clearly identifiable. Do not add lorem ipsum or random labels. No title card or explanatory text outside the application UI.
DIRECTION 1: CALM WORKSPACE. A refined, comfortable, polished productivity tool. Modest 224px integrated left sidebar with compact repo switcher, primary navigation, a search field, and case folder tree. A large central DOCUMENT CANVAS is the clear focus, with max-width readable 850px content aligned within the available width, not a tiny text block in empty space. Top app chrome about 52px. Case breadcrumb, title, status/tags on one clean property row, Save in the top right of editor header. Hierarchy through typography, whitespace and subtly layered dark surfaces, radius 8px, very few outlines. Section content has breathing room without huge paddings; visible four sections fit in viewport. No permanent right inspector, no dashboard cards, no footer diagnostics. A convincing calm, mature premium design that balances warmth and utility. Full screenshot of this single proposed style.

corrections.prompt:
Edit this existing Testoritto UI screenshot with only these precise corrections; preserve the overall dark Citadelic visual style, split-view catalog/detail layout, sizing, case selection, text typography and all other content.
1. Under left heading "Рабочие области", replace the existing list entirely with just these three QA workspace choices: selected "Платежи" with folder icon, then "Авторизация" with folder icon, then "Личный кабинет" with folder icon. Remove "Пользователи", "Каталог", "Заказы", "Уведомления", "Настройки" and their business/account/settings icons. There is no application user management or settings screen in this concept. Leave intentional empty sidebar space below workspaces.
2. In the center case catalog, the amber status on PAY-043 must read exactly "Черновик", replacing "На проверке". Other active statuses unchanged.
3. In the right-side "Шаги" table, remove the entire "Ожидаемый результат" per-step column. The table has only two columns: "#" about 45px, and "Шаг" taking the remaining available width. Keep the existing 3 numbered step texts and row overflow menus at far right. Do not invent per-step expected-results fields; there is already one supported global "Ожидаемый результат" section below, which must stay unchanged.
No additional UI features or text. This remains a high fidelity realistic application concept screenshot in Russian, not marketing artwork.
